text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out and about with
Aston
Machan...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice Aston Machan eyeing a claw
machine
filled with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well, those are competitors to my
Machan dolls.
So yes, I'd like to get one
for research purposes
and see what
makes them so popular.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Is it the texture? The fluffiness? Maybe
the
stitching? There are so many aspects
I want to
examine.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's not enough just to have Machan
merch on
store shelves. I want everyone
who buys it to be
thrilled with their
purchase.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then mini Machan and I will be
cheering
for you. Go get 'em.
choice_data_list: それなら、研究のために取ってあげよう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
